description: This file defines the 'Footer' controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It extends the system engine controller and provides a method to assemble data for rendering the website footer, including links to informational pages, customer account actions, and online user tracking. It also loads necessary assets and sub-controllers.

classes.name: Footer
classes.description: Controller class for rendering the footer section of the website, includes logic for assembling footer links, tracking online users, and loading footer view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to gather footer data, including links to informational pages, customer account links, and online user tracking, then renders the footer view.
